title: Sour German Sauerkraut Bake
description: A hearty and tangy German-inspired casserole featuring sauerkraut, sausage, and a blend of sweet and sour flavors.

ingredients.name: and sausage
ingredients.notes: you can choose the type you like

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sauerkraut, sweet potatoes, luscious sauer, and german seasonings.
In a separate pan, cook sausage over medium heat until browned.
Add sour cream to the pan and stir until combined with sausage.
Combine sausage mixture with sauerkraut mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes.
